answer_1.quote: We propose applying, for the first time, a generative seq2seq model to the lexical substitution task... By finetuning a pre‑trained model to produce substitutes starting from a word in its context.
answer_1.outputs: a comma‑separated list of substitute words for the target word in its context

answer_2.quote: We report our results in Table ... using the standard metrics for lexical substitution, i.e., best and oot... In addition to the standard metrics, we also report p@1, p@3 and r@10.

answer_4.quote: We set up a test where an annotator is provided with a target word in context and a set of substitutes... The annotators are asked to select the inappropriate substitutes.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators must select all substitutes that are not suitable replacements; guidelines state a substitute is wrong if it is an inflection of the target, changes the sentence meaning, or results in a syntactically wrong sentence.
